text:
Well, well... Look who's here.
You kept my secret from the king's advisor, Edmon, which I am grateful for.
zh:
哟，哟……瞧瞧这是谁来了。
你没把我的秘密捅给国王的顾问埃德蒙，这份情我记着。

text:
Well, well... Look who decided to show up.
The guy who ratted me out to Edmon.
zh:
哟，哟……瞧瞧是谁大驾光临了。
就是这家伙向埃德蒙告发了我。

text:
I may not look like it, but I hold grudges.
Very strongly...
zh:
别看我这样，我可是个记仇的人。
非常记仇……

text: If I could fight, I'd gladly bury a knife between your ribs right now.
zh: 要是我能动手，现在就乐意把刀捅进你的肋骨缝里。

text: Good thing I've got raiders for that.
zh: 好在这种事有掠夺者替我干。

text:
Oi! Fatso!
You've got someone to play with!
zh:
喂！死胖子！
有人来陪你玩了！

text: But now you're sneaking around our raider tunnels. And that really crosses the line, you know?
zh: 可你现在竟敢在我们掠夺者的隧道里鬼鬼祟祟。这可就太过分了，你知道吗？

text: If I could fight, I'd play it safe and stick a knife between your ribs right now.
zh: 要是我能动手，我肯定图个稳妥，现在就把刀插进你的肋骨缝里。

text: You shouldn't be sneaking around our raider tunnels. This is a dangerous place, you know?
zh: 你不该在我们掠夺者的隧道里鬼鬼祟祟。这地方很危险，你知道吗？
